scenario.name: balanced
scenario.description: A clear day with midday solar, evening tariffs, and flexible training.
scenario.provenance: Synthetic data; illustrative assumptions, not a measured facility.

solver.scope: Causal renewable forecasts; no global optimality claim
solver.forecast_policy: Day-ahead forecasts; zero future renewables in closing guard slots; current actual observed

notes: All inputs are synthetic and do not predict real-world savings.
Oracle sees actual future renewables; rolling control sees only the current observation and future forecast.
Reserved jobs and inference demand are known; unexpected job arrivals are not modeled.
Operating cost excludes carbon externalities and hardware/renewable/storage capital costs.
